reviewContext: Initial technical Luna review was conditional: budget units and ceilings, finite canonical JSON, response invariants, monotonic deadline and cancellation publication needed resolution.

decisions.choice: Hard inclusive 1048576 raw UTF-8 bytes before parsing and canonical bytes after validation; bounded read of limit plus one.
Python stdlib finite JSON, sorted object keys, arrays preserved, UTF-8 without Unicode normalization, SHA256, container depth 16; no cross-language canonical-number guarantee.

Explicit required integer caller budgets: maxInputBytes 1..1048576, maxQuestions 1..32, maxOptions 2..32, maxTokens 1..1048576 character-token units, deadlineMs 1..5000; booleans/unknown fields rejected.
Offline stdlib-rule-fixture-v1 backend with synthetic-reference-v1 capability and hand-authored one-hot fixture mappings; no natural-language inference, source collection or trained model.
Default strict-uncalibrated-v1 abstains; explicit synthetic-diagnostic-v1 may answer fixtures. Calibration absent, calibratedProbability omitted, authority always denied.
Answered publishes the complete batch and distribution; abstain/defer/refused publish no answers. Input refusal before full validation has null caller identities/digests and sanitized reason codes.

Deep immutable request records, one active request/eight waiting, no retries/cache; monotonic ingress deadline, request-local irreversible cancellation, publication lock suppresses late answers without claiming hard compute termination.
Reference renders the whole canonical request and advertises character-token-v1, binary64 and explicit context cap; neural tokenizer/device/memory/rights envelopes remain separate gates.

T002–T008 implement only the exact stdlib profile; neural worker/device limits are future only. API ingress is materialized bounded bytes before parse; CLI bounded regular-file I/O excluded from core deadline, no stdin/socket or hard filesystem read claim.

reviewRequired: Fresh independent Luna technical review bound to exact contract bytes before code; unresolved findings retain the implementation stop gate.
limits: Technical proposals only. No task or assurance status is changed; no human review, workload benefit, calibration, source permission, model/device support or capability promotion follows.
